meta.title: SalaryKitten — a desktop pet that counts your salary in real time
meta.description: A free, open-source chibi desktop pet for macOS and Windows. Watch today's salary tick up every second, get greeted at work, reminded at lunch and cheered when you hit your goal.
nav.label: Main
hero.title: Your salary, counted second by second.
hero.lead: A chibi desktop pet that sits on your screen and counts what you've earned today in real time. She greets you at work, sends you to lunch, cheers when you hit your goal and sees you off at the end of the day.
hero.fine: macOS 12+ (Apple silicon & Intel, signed and notarized) · Windows 10/11 x64 · free, no account, data stays on your computer
hero.shotAlt: Five SalaryKitten characters on the desktop, each with a speech bubble and today's earnings
facts.label: At a glance
facts.charsSub: 9 poses and her own lines each
features.title: A tiny coworker who loves payday
f1.title: Live salary counter
f1.body: Today's earnings tick up every 0.1 s on your desktop and in the macOS menu bar. Lunch is unpaid and the counter stops after work.
f2.title: Work-day reminders
f2.body: A greeting when work starts and a goodbye with today's total when it ends, as a speech bubble and a system notification.
f3.title: Lunch reminders
f3.body: A heads-up a few minutes before lunch, “time to eat!” when it starts and a nudge when the break is over.
f4.title: Daily goal
f4.body: Set a goal like ¥100 and she waves a flag and throws confetti the moment you earn it.
f5.title: Boss mode
f5.body: One click hides every amount: bubbles, notifications and the menu bar. Click-through on empty space, drag anywhere, or drag her to the screen edge to tuck her in.
f6.title: Auto-update
f6.body: Checks GitHub Releases in the background and tells you when a signed update is ready to install.
formula: monthly salary ÷ paid days per month ÷ working seconds per day
formula.note: Set your salary, working days, hours, lunch break, currency (CNY, USD, JPY, KRW, EUR) and decimals. 21.75 paid days per month by default.
chars.title: Pick your coworker
chars.lead: Switch any time from the right-click menu. Each one has 9 poses (working, lunch nap, celebrating, hungry…) and reacts differently when you poke her.
